title: Activate /admin Admin Panel with AdMob settings, logo update, and user management

requirements.text: Make the Admin Panel accessible at the path /admin (not only via hash routing), so that visiting https://<app-domain>/admin loads the Admin Panel UI and the in-app “Admin Panel” navigation button uses /admin.

quotes: Please activate the Admin Panel UI at /admin so I can see the settings to enter my AdMob IDs, update the Logo, and manage users. Show me these fields now.

acceptanceCriteria: When an authenticated admin navigates directly to /admin, the Admin Panel page renders (no manual #/admin hash required).
When an admin clicks the header navigation toggle, the URL switches between / and /admin and the correct panel renders.
Non-admin users visiting /admin see the existing Access Denied UI.

requirements.text: Ensure the Admin Panel “AdMob Settings” section always renders for admins and correctly loads/saves the AdMob App ID and Rewarded Ad Unit ID using the backend APIs, with stable form state initialization (no state updates during render).
acceptanceCriteria: As an admin, the Admin Panel shows inputs labeled “AdMob App ID” and “Rewarded Ad Unit ID”.
On first load, if values exist in the backend, the inputs are pre-filled with those values; if not, inputs are empty.
Clicking “Save” persists the trimmed values and shows an English success toast; backend errors show an English error toast.
The page does not spam React warnings/errors about setting state during render.

requirements.text: Add admin-configurable app logo management: provide Admin Panel UI to upload/replace a logo image, persist it in the backend, and display the saved logo in the app header in place of the default icon when available.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Panel contains a “Logo” (or “Branding”) section with a file picker and a clear Save/Update action.
Uploaded logo is persisted in the backend and remains available after refresh/relogin.
App header displays the uploaded logo (with reasonable sizing/cropping) when present; otherwise it falls back to the current default icon.
Only admins can upload/replace the logo; non-admin calls are rejected.

requirements.text: Implement real user management/overview in the Admin Panel: add backend admin-only APIs to list users and their stored profiles and session status, and update the Admin Panel to display this list (replacing the current placeholder).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an admin-only method to fetch an overview of known users including: principal, optional profile (name), and whether a session exists (and expiry if available).
Admin Panel “Users & Sessions Overview” section displays a table/list of users showing principal, name (if set), and session status.
The user overview loads only for admins and shows an English loading state and an English empty-state when there are no users.
Non-admin callers cannot access the overview API (traps/returns an authorization error).

requirements.text: Persist new/updated admin settings across upgrades: store global AdMob config and the uploaded logo in stable state, and add/adjust conditional migration logic as needed to preserve existing values on upgrade.

quotes: My app is now live. Please activate the Admin Panel UI at /admin so I can see the settings to enter my AdMob IDs, update the Logo, and manage users. Show me these fields now.

acceptanceCriteria: After redeploy/upgrade, previously saved AdMob App ID + Rewarded Ad Unit ID values are still returned by getAppAdMobConfig().
After redeploy/upgrade, previously uploaded logo is still returned/displayed.
If migration is required, it is implemented using backend/migration.mo per the project’s conditional migration policy.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only).
Do not edit immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Integrating real Google AdMob ads into a native mobile client (this project remains a web prototype for ad flow).
Adding third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
